films.syn: The film documents the real life of experimental hip-hop group Choolers Division and their time as artists-in-residence at the art brut center “La S” in Belgium. Their members are giving a glimpse into a cacophony of deep friendship and unbridled creativity in a world that often seeks to ignore them.

Shy Totsuko sees the aura of others as colours. But she cannot see her own colour. On the surface, Totsuko’s story is about the founding of a band. But in this “slice-of-life” anime, director Naoko Yamada closely examines the emotional worlds of her characters.
Could the world look totally different to how we know it? This film presents a humorous look at an unusual, mysterious story of creation. A philosophical film about the coincidences of our existence.

films.t: The Girl Who Lived in the Loo
films.syn: A ten-year-old girl has discovered the loo as her haven and the ultimate solution to all her problems. She eats in the loo, plays in the loo and, if she could, she would sleep in there, too. Her journey through life, as she moves from one bathroom to another, remains calm and secure, but also somewhat lonely.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 9)

films.syn: Anxious teenager Ūla is taken on an unexpected adventure during her swimming practice, as she spots a blue mark on her thigh. As she becomes one with water, she becomes one with herself.

ap.p: Bagno II: A Fish out of Water
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Bagno II: A Fish out of Water)

films.syn: Mantou and his foster father Daguzi are searching for a legendary ship and a treasure. They soon find themselves in a conflict of mythical proportions. The visually overwhelming animated cartoon is heavily inspired by Chinese culture and deals with the topics of family and perseverance.
On this exclusive luxury cruise two families meet, while artificial facades dissolve, psychedelic dreamworlds unfold and the reality beyond superficial comfort is unveiled.

A princess and a swineherd are bored. Boredom leads to creativity – but does the King agree with the way in which the princess and the swineherd entertain themselves? The 3D computer-animated film retells an old Danish fairy tale in an amusing way.

films.t: There Are People in the Forest
films.syn: A lonely man limps down the road. A truck drives up to him. Several armed men jump out of it. They capture the limping man and transport him to the forest. The only witnesses of the scene are people from a nearby village.

films.t: This Is a Story Without a Plan
films.syn: Two characters are witnessing a constant explosion in different fragments of their lives. A tale of observers.

Flickering, clinking, stroboscopic glinting. A torso in full abstraction. Sunspots and pulsating synapses, small explosions and dancing light particles. The body succumbs to looking into the light and follows wild choreography into the glittering inner depths.

Three orange circles, like afterimages on the retina. Bodies in constant motion, they get bigger and smaller again, inevitable on their paths. Their orbits leave traces whose touchpoints, overlaps and gaps bear witness to the fact that in this galaxy, too, everything is related.

films.t: To Know to Fall is a Science – a garota não

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 9)

films.t: Too Late – Chinese Man feat. Stogie T, KT Gorique & FP

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 9)

films.syn: Fitting in with the norm can be really tiring. This is what the small piece of wood experiences in this stop motion film, which tries to be like all the others.

Metaprocesses in stroboscopic macro shots. Bubbling, flickering, pulsating. Forms explode, flourish, bloom. Through the adoption and disassociation of scientific films of the 1920s, entire universes are captured in miniature.
A new family member can turn everything on its head. A mouse family realises this in this puppet animated film when they take in and care for an injured baby bat.

Distorted structures, data storage media converted to outdated footage. The equipment sends remembrance into a spin. Layers of storage. A hypnotic spiral appears to emanate from hints of the in-between, in which the physicality and non-linear forms of remembering find a place.

Mary, Billybud and Fumbleton are three characters from the children’s TV series “Wander to Wonder” from the 1980s. After their creator died, they were left alone in the studio. In their slowly decaying costumes and with growing hunger, they continue to play episodes for their fans, but these episodes become more and more strange.

When the King of Watermelon Island dies, he realises that he has never cared for others in his life. Then Watermelon Girl grows from his grave. With her, everything could be different – but first she has to learn on an adventurous journey that life is more fun with friends.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Bagno I: Waves of Change)

films.syn: The film explores the complex relationship between humans and water, taking the audience on an emotional journey. Charcoal animation creates compelling contrasts between wetness and dryness, fluidity and rigidity, light and darkness. Sound plays a crucial role in clarifying the film’s connection to water and intensifies the effect of the images.

Each of the 3000 single frames shows an insect. As the colours on their bodies and wings glow and change, it seems as if the genetic process of millions of years is taking place in a few minutes, defying the arguments of evolutionary biologists and fundamentalists. It is like a mescaline dream of Charles Darwin.

The dreamy romantic drama from Studio Ghibli is based on real-life Tokyo and features books, a mysterious cat and an unforgettable version of “Country Roads”. The film was directed by Yoshifumi Kondô, Miyazaki’s would-be successor who died just after releasing his far too rarely shown debut.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: All we need is love)

films.syn: A movie about a breakup. The narrative develops through the author’s conversations with his long-time partner, and follows the contemplation of the end of a nine-year romantic relationship.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 9)

films.syn: A beetle loses his home in a forest fire and is separated from his family. But he develops a surprising skill that helps him find his way back home. This moving Czech animated film tells the story of how difficult circumstances can lead us to develop new skills.

A pool? Or is it a desert? Overlays of sand and water. Flooded images, fragile textures and fluid masses form a projection room and trick observers from the dry reality into the shipping channel of imagination.
A strange interaction between a wandering man and a mysterious creature.

Anka loves cats. And Jesus. In a winter silence the lagoon freezes and the unspoken resurfaces like crack on ice. Mosaic portrait of a small fisherman's village where human to human, human to animal, animal to animal interdepend on a delicate balance of warm tender care and cold emotional cruelty.

Every year, Paul, his family and their friends attend the eternal «August 15 picnic» on Callot Island. But this year, they find themselves trapped by the tide. Paul, upset, stuck between the world of adults and that of children, becomes aware of his individuality.
During a protest, two law enforcement teams face off on the field and exercise their brutality.

A monkey raised by humans traces his mother’s footsteps to a sacred mountain to uncover the secret of fire. Using traditional Chinese ink painting, Li Wenyu reimagines an archaic legend of the Qiang people in a poetic fable about the creation of humankind.

A man and a woman have been married for years. They are bogged down in the stifling routine of the everyday. Something must change. The painful emptiness between and within the two people needs to be filled with love, otherwise it will be impossible to live on. Do they realise that their life together is not coincidence, but God’s own plan?

“After a Whale” follows the journey of a young woman in search of peace. She visits a swimming pool and enters a meditative state. Suddenly, the pool turns dark, and a killer whale passes her by. She joins him for a swim. When the girl touches the killer whale, a new connection is formed between two neurons. She reaches a higher state of awareness. A news report from another time reveals a dead whale washed ashore. Unable to bury such a large creature, the locals decide to blow it up. Despite the strange events, life continues, and so does her search for peace – even after the whale.

What if the golden era of US cartoons never ended? It’s hilarious how that silly old Groompy keeps getting smacked around by Yummy, who’s a real trickster! But did you realise that Groompy is actually a genuine actor? Did you know he is caught in a miserable routine both on screen and in real life?
An old Beirut resident checks the obituaries page and attends funerals daily. His “mourning” routine reveals a journey of grieving and accepting the loss of his love, his home and his city.

films.t: Amélie et la métaphysique des tubes
films.syn: Three-year-old Amélie believes she is a god but gradually comes to understand her place in the world. With a keen eye for detail, Maïlys Vallade and Liane-Cho Han Jin Kuang have adapted the autobiographical novel by the Belgian author Amélie Nothomb, who grew up in Japan, resulting in an emotionally captivating burst of colour.

A landscape disappears. The wind begins to transform what seems immovable, sometimes like a breath of life, sometimes like a windstorm. A notebook that collects landscapes eagerly seeks how to keep a record of it.

Arco lives in a far future and is still too young to travel back into the past as a rainbow. When he secretly tries to do so, he turns the life of Iris, who is the same age, upside down. This Annecy-award-winning science-fiction utopia by comic book author Ugo Bienvenu paints an inspirational vision of the future.
Esther observes the stars through a telescope. Next to her, a human–fish creature tries in vain to attract her attention. After all, isn’t the underwater world just as interesting as the starry sky?
The beach at a Chinese resort is crowded. People are enjoying their summer holidays. A sudden thunderstorm causes them to run away in all directions.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Camping on the Ocean Floor)

films.syn: Waiting at a traffic light becomes an ordeal.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 10)

films.syn: The legendary tapeworm diet of the world’s most famous opera diva is told in a tragicomic way from the perspective of the tapeworm Alexis.
To be a “good” girl in Central Asia, you must memorise rules invented by men.
In order to paint a masterpiece for an upcoming exhibition, an artist steals the object of his desire from a young woman. The fraud is discovered and his art turns into a farce.

An animated documentary that explores the phenomenon of bodybuilding and examines the relationship fitness-oriented men have with their own bodies. Through interviews the film presents the stories of three men who use exercise to cope with inner struggles that have often resulted in low self-esteem.
An animated short film for children about tolerance towards others. The proverbial “black sheep” is bullied out of the flock, but only the brave outsider can protect them from harm.
Blending psychedelic animation with haunting music. Centred around a black cat, it explores themes of misfortune and the uncanny through dreamlike visuals and Maki Asakawa’s melancholic song.

ap.p: If You Love Cats, This Is for You!
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: If You Love Cats, This Is for You!)

films.syn: A man lives alone with his dog. He is haunted by the memory of a mysterious creature he encountered in the forest as a child.

ap.p: As if They Were Breathing – Uncanny Puppets in Motion
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: As if They Were Breathing – Uncanny Puppets in Motion)

films.syn: A hand draws a stick figure, brings it to life, plays with it and finally releases it into freedom.
Bobel is a toadstool who dreams of becoming a chef at the village market. But as a poisonous mushroom, he has to face the villagers’ prejudices. Until a friend helps him.
A woman discovers her own fractured self in the room next door. “Body Echo” expresses psychological fragility and the fragmentation of identity.

ap.p: As if They Were Breathing – Uncanny Puppets in Motion
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: As if They Were Breathing – Uncanny Puppets in Motion)

films.syn: Our body remembers more than we can ever imagine. It also remembers the sorrow and pain of our predecessors, preserving the stories of our parents and grandparents and theirs before them. But, how far back in the body’s memory is it possible to go?
In this travelogue, the director depicts his personal experiences and encounters across India and how it feels travelling through his home country.
When a bus seat is overly reclined by a passenger, the passenger behind questions the meaning of the space we all inhabit. What happens if no one cares about the space around you?

While his friends are enjoying their holiday, a dim-witted teenager from Florida tries to rake in heaps of money delivering food. With warm-hearted laconicism, Julian Glander’s amusing coming-of-age story immerses us in an isometrically streamlined suburb teeming with colourful absurdities.

On the outskirts of Tokyo lives Miho, a lonely elderly widow. On her daily trip to the supermarket, she encounters a hungry stray cat. The cat follows her home and soon makes himself more comfortable in her small apartment than she could ever have imagined.

ap.p: If You Love Cats, This Is for You!
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: If You Love Cats, This Is for You!)

films.syn: Nastia, who has been living abroad for years, begins to teach her mother how to use internet services. Over time, these interactions uncover generational conflicts and long-forgotten family ties. Can the intimacy regained via Zoom be a turning point for the future relationship between the two adults?

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 10)

films.syn: This cheesy, sweet music video is a thank you to all the people and organisations who take care of stray animals.

ap.p: If You Love Cats, This Is for You!
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: If You Love Cats, This Is for You!)

films.syn: The chronicle of a cat’s misadventures in a park.

ap.p: If You Love Cats, This Is for You!
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: If You Love Cats, This Is for You!)

films.syn: This is a story about relationships and how they can shape our lives forever. Maybe it’s just a story about a man and a cat. But a good one.

ap.p: If You Love Cats, This Is for You!
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: If You Love Cats, This Is for You!)

films.syn: This is the story of an introvert facing the challenges of constantly being pushed to be more outgoing.

A mermaid confesses her love to Stephan, an office worker, who then stumbles into a wedding that his boss is using to make a peace offering to the local sea creatures. This fast-paced play on clichés features outrageous designs, detailed animation and outlandish humour.
On one of the last days of summer, a young man gets ready to leave his family home.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Camping on the Ocean Floor)

films.t: Chun Tae-il: A Flame That Lives On
films.syn: It’s 1964. Young Chun Tae-il arrives in Seoul and gets hired as a tailor’s assistant at the grand Pyeonghwa Market. He dreams of becoming a fully-fledged tailor to financially support his family. However, Chun Tae-il and his co-workers face drastically poor labour conditions that are slowly breaking them down.
Sitting on the toilet, Mika is shocked to discover something slimy in her underpants. In search of answers, she embarks on a bizarre journey into her own vagina.

aw: Youth Award for best new talent

films.syn: A unicorn that loses its horn turns into a crow, but the starfish doesn’t care about that until a barber falls in love with the starfish. A story inspired by Asian parent–child relationships.

Bernie Krause’s “niche theory” is that each creature’s voice evolved to occupy its own unique little acoustic slot within the all-encompassing soundscape, a piece of the whole puzzle, distinct within the sea of sonic information. A fisher wonders what sounds fit best in the acoustic niches created by the surroundings.

An ever-evolving landscape where the present inevitably coexists with the past. Memories are formed, reshaped and obliterated, relentlessly competing for space. Control is surrendered, and mistakes and second chances are embraced. It is the slow stampede of a vulnerable mind.

At the 1999 International Vegetarian Congress in Widnau, a small village in eastern Switzerland, a mysterious case of food poisoning occurs. When the animators Marion and Noah come across the story, they decide to make an animated documentary about the case. Where does the truth lie 20 years on?

A constantly freezing man in his forties drives to a lonely petrol station every evening and orders a microwaved Hawaiian toastie. Detlev indulges in this bizarre ritual, the only thing that warms his everyday life. But when he is observed by a stranger one night, his world crumbles into pieces of shame.

films.t: Die innovative und traditionelle Seite von Animation
films.syn: Have you ever wondered how animated films were made 50 years ago and how they are made today? We’ll show you exactly that.

An episode in the “Radiovision” series that explores the vast Radio Belgrade archives. Animated impression of the last interview with Isidora Sekulić (1877–1958), one of the most famous Yugoslav writers, thinkers, culture critics and polyglots.
Ills of fortune have landed ballet dancer Sergei at a suburban collective farm. Here he struggles day after day with the mindless routine, domestic animals and alcohol.

In a world that demands community participation, individual desires inevitably collide. When small, everyday actions trigger unexpected consequences, a group of neighbours are suddenly forced into interactions that challenge their independence.

films.t: Don't Make It a Song – Camel Power Club

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 10)

films.syn: Real estate shark Akio Kashiwagi has built an empire on stolen money. Blinded by greed and unaware that he is being hunted by an American, he accepts a dangerous gamble that might cost him his life. Inspired by booming 1980s Tokyo, told in stop-motion puppet animation.

A battle for our attention has suddenly become a real war. Information technology is not merely seen as a means to an end but as something that has its own agency, as an acting force that renders horrific events possible, events that are very hard to accept and almost impossible to comprehend.
Everyone is a virtuoso on their instrument, but only when people play together does this transform into music.
Ernesto, a stick figure in an empty white picture space, finds a bottle of black ink – and the inevitable chaos begins. Animated pantomime at its best.

In a God-fearing village lying between two rivers, giving birth to a fačuk – an illegitimate child – is a mortal sin. When a young woman gets pregnant, it is not only a child that grows inside her but also fear born of her narrow-minded and harsh rural environment.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 10)

films.syn: The film is inspired by factory work and reimagines the production process. Let’s see what happens when automation turns into abstraction, the assembly line takes curves and twists, and the workers control the choreography of their own movements.
The musician Miles walks alone down a street. When he enters a bar, memories of his deceased brother come flooding back. The flashbacks catch up with him.

“Flè dè me” is an experimental film about four-year-old Bathschèba’s retelling of their adoption story. Young Bathschèba takes us through their fears of coming to America and the strange, silly and scary new things about this country in order to unpack the complexity of their childhood.

What is work? In physics, it’s the transfer of energy. Force moves an object, carries it some distance. But how does it actually work? And what about us – how do we work? What for? Why work? A story about a worker, a wooden god, some eggs and animals.

The interactions between figure and paper, animating person and animated world, and tuba and double bass lead to dynamic confrontations and balancing acts. The environment is constantly reshaped by overlapping sheets of paper. A space is created in which the figure transcends the boundaries between the frames.

films.t: Hit the Nail on the Head
films.syn: At the end of a long day, the domestic routine is interrupted by irritating inconveniences – a reflection on the problems that life brings with it.

Frida is a cheerful first-grader who falls ill with polio and is ostracised by the other children. But she refuses to let this bring her down and decides to become a doctor. With a great deal of tenderness and imagination, this French-Canadian family film highlights the childhood and youth of Mexican artist Frida Kahlo.
A hero on a quest to find other men on a virtual dating platform. Identified as an “Arab” by others, he finds himself both celebrated by white gay males and hated by French police officers.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 10)

films.syn: Ayla wakes up in a mountainous landscape, surrounded only by vegetation and a river. Driven by curiosity and a desire to get to know the place, she goes on a journey of discovery and diving. As she discovers where she is, she also discovers herself.

This daring animated mockumentary sees felt puppets confronted with a ramified bureaucracy and life-and-death questions – among them: What should they become when they have lost their usefulness? Emma de Swaef’s and Marc Roels’s “Oh, Willy” meets Yiorgos Lanthimos’s “The Lobster”.
Fatmeh shares how food has played a crucial role in her life in Iran, how it helped her digest, navigate and heal traumatic experiences.
A boy and an elephant get lost in a labyrinth. This Czech animated film stands out for its traditional style: it is hand-drawn on paper using coloured pencils.

A puppet animation documentary about Iiti’s moving day, which goes awry. An eerie mouse haunts her new home — a twisted omen for her poor life choices. As her efforts to get rid of the mouse escalate, Iiti is confronted with a disturbing question: could she herself be the mouse?

ap.p: As if They Were Breathing – Uncanny Puppets in Motion
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: As if They Were Breathing – Uncanny Puppets in Motion)

films.syn: During her stay in hospital, the filmmaker repeatedly experiences absurd, funny moments between pain, homesickness and disgust with her own body. Meanwhile, she tries to come to terms with the hospital’s own procedures and hierarchies. An emotional trip through the underground corridors of the hospital.
A poetic meditation on the magic of the moving image and the nature of the medium.
Dimitri the clown must first climb a mountain and defeat a dragon if he wants his beloved back.

A young woman seeks a break in the tranquillity of the mountains. But her peace is disturbed – unfortunately, there are people everywhere. Now only nature can help her. Frantic pencil strokes underline how stressful the most peaceful places in Switzerland can become.

Three friends graduate with degrees in animation, share a flat, and look for jobs in the industry. While one of them lands an internship and fights the drift into corporate culture, the other two navigate the maze of platform service industries and/or unemployment. Powerpuff Girls forever!

films.t: Is That All There Is – Mary Coughlan

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 10)

films.syn: A metro ride from one stop to the next. An exchange of sneezes. People tapping away on their phones. Pigeons gossiping. An experiment that merges the feel of 3D photogrammetry and traditional charcoal animation. The dream of a sleeping city.

In just 18 months, Ryuya Suzuki created this abstract feature film practically single-handedly, telling the life story of an anonymous pop idol. Using absolute reduction and ironic detachment, the film addresses the personal and social problems of yesterday, today and tomorrow.

Loving siblings Jonas and Lysa are forced to make difficult choices to survive. This award-winning collaboration between Brazilian animators and the NFB uses satire and caricature to explore dramatic subjects such as violence against minors, child labour exploitation and child homelessness.
On a school trip to Italy, three school friends share a bedroom in a convent.
Eager to create a monumental work of art, a shaman remains blissfully unaware that she is painting her murals inside the mouth of a vain weather presenter.

On a trip to the forest with her school class, ten-year-old Marlene struggles with her changing body. When the other children make fun of a strange-looking tadpole, Marlene identifies with it in a special way and decides to set it free.

films.t: Kihachirō Kawamoto: The Book of the Dead
films.syn: Renowned puppet animator Kihachirō Kawamoto was born in Tokyo in 1925. To mark his 100th birthday, we are bringing back to the big screen his magnum opus: “The Book of the Dead”. In mesmerising images, this Buddhist fable tells a story of love and forgiveness in Japan during the Nara period.

ap.p: Kihachirō Kawamoto: The Book of the Dead
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Kihachirō Kawamoto: The Book of the Dead)

films.syn: A young Kingfisher is thrown out of the nest and must now fend for himself, without his parents’ help. This turns out to be quite challenging.

Olga’s everyday life at the kiosk is uninspiring. When it’s quiet, she dreams of travelling to an exotic country. Then everything changes suddenly, and Olga becomes involved in a disaster along with the kiosk. Unexpectedly, her long-cherished dream becomes reality.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Kurzfilme in der Kirche)
Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 10)

films.syn: Following a failed assassination attempt, the conflicted activist Hélène is haunted by the ghost of a fellow activist. She becomes overwhelmed by feelings of guilt, self-doubt and justifications. As she loses certainty, the images and colours of Félix Dufour-Laperrière’s visual language also shift.

The goddess Timbehes creates the earth and humans by fertilising herself with a banana. Her creation is marvellous and idyllic. But the more people there are, the greater their hunger becomes. A critical look at our approach to consumption based on the most consumed fruit in Europe. Made entirely by bananas.

A young woman lives a lonely and isolated life, dreaming of luxury and beauty. Her greatest desires are to look like her famous idol and to win the heart of her secret love. In a surreal, dream-like turn of events, in which a moth-like ghost appears, she realises that not all wishes were meant to be fulfilled.

At a memorial service for his father, journalist Feurat Alani reflects on his family history that links France and Iraq. With poignant graphic simplicity, the animated documentary also provides valuable insight into Iraq’s turbulent recent history.
Two children from different parts of the world encounter each other after digging a tunnel on the beach. Together they dig their way to the North Pole, where they discover a magical way home.

films.t: Lenas Hof: Der Stachel im Po
films.syn: The hedgehog is about to go into hibernation when he realises that one of his spines is missing. The spine is stuck in Lena’s dog’s bum, of all places. It won’t be easy to get it back ...

Gaspard is still in love with Leïla. A month after she left him, they meet in a crowded bar. As the meeting goes awry and he feels the tears welling up, Gaspard takes refuge under the tablecloth. Away from prying eyes and closer to memories.
A commissioned work for Expo Switzerland 02. A butterfly and a magician guide us through a magical world.

In an attempt to rescue her kidnapped ex-girlfriend, the overprotected princess Saira finds herself on an inter-gay-lactic adventure. Emma Hough Hobbs and Leela Varghese won the Teddy Award in Berlin for this queer sci-fi comedy with unfiltered humour, imperfect heroines and a whole lot of heart.
Herman is a rat who lives alone in a messy apartment. One day, a very tidy cat shows up at his doorstep – with all her belongings.

ap.p: If You Love Cats, This Is for You!
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: If You Love Cats, This Is for You!)

films.syn: “Lights, Haze” explores the ambivalence of memory through real locations on the outskirts of Tbilisi.
This film is about the connection between humans and animals and the sharing of a common habitat. The habitats face each other in a similarly critical state.

An animator discusses a scene from the TV series “The Sopranos” while meticulously crafting stop-motion recreations of his family’s home movies. He tries to fill the gaps in his leaking memories through the shared Italian-American idiosyncrasies of the show and his past.

A powerful tale based on truth, a story that is both universal and local. Through the ongoing practices of Western colonisation in Congo, an exploitative economy overtakes public and individual lives, turning people into machines and reality into dystopia.
A day in the life of a shoeshine boy in Bolivia’s capital La Paz.

Twelve-year-old Mary loves nothing more than searching for fossils on the beach. When her father disappears, she has to push back on social conventions and authorities. Marcel Barelli has set the story of the English palaeontologist in a heartwarming family film. England in the year 1811: The father of 12-year-old Mary Anning, a passionate fossil collector, disappears, leaving behind a cryptic drawing. To provide for her family and uncover his secret, Mary defies social norms and braves the dangerous cliffs of Dorset. Courageous and curious, she discovers numerous fossils as well as their place in history. The film celebrates the early contributions of real-life palaeontologist Mary Anning (1799 – 1847), while shedding light on gender-based prejudice in science through a historical yet youthful lens. “Mary Anning” is an eloquent story about science, resilience and a young girl who changed the world. By using a light-hearted contemporary dialogue between a child and her father, the feature film by Swiss animator Marcel Barelli makes historical facts entertaining and easy to understand. The film combines humour with feminist criticism and reveals how important Anning’s fossil discoveries were for palaeontology, even though she was excluded from the scientific canon for a long time because of her gender and social status. (Xenia Nguyen)
In the ’70s, three rebellious teenage daughters, a restless mother, a father struggling with potatoes, and maybe some elephants find themselves in bustling Nairobi. What could possibly go wrong?
A fire ignites, and a boy’s fantasies about a girl dissolve into a haunting reality he can’t escape.

Time after time, Grace is faced with the loss of family and friends and tells her favourite snail Sylvia about it. Following “Mary and Max”, Australian Adam Elliot has once again succeeded in creating a soul-stirring tragicomedy with melancholy misfits and piercing, wry humour.
A young woman picks up a dead dragonfly and looks into its eyes. For a brief moment, she is transported back to her childhood and memories of her grandmother.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Camping on the Ocean Floor)

films.syn: A spaceship flies past an unknown planet. A group of robots and a cat set off to explore this planet.
Miisu, a virtual pet cat, grows weary of her owner and begins to rebel. The Tamagotchi-inspired “Miisufy” invites us to view the world from the perspective of virtual animals.
A girl who wants to live alone receives a visitor: a cat knocks on her door. That moment changes everything.

ap.p: If You Love Cats, This Is for You!
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: If You Love Cats, This Is for You!)

films.syn: Mojappi are three cheeky little animals that live in the forest. When they see that their friends are eating pancakes, they do everything they can to get them.

“Maaimä” is a song for Mother Earth. It tells of the difficult relationship between humans and nature, comparing humans to bugs on the skin of the Earth. The song addresses topical issues such as the climate crisis, overpopulation and consumption. It was written by poet Leila Holts in one of the oldest languages in the world, Võro, thus also referring to indigenous cultures, whose peoples serve as guardians of nature in today’s world, warning us of the danger of our destructive ways.

Being a loving mother and handling a full-time career every day is a battle for Mary. While she still struggles to fully understand her disabled son Murphy’s needs, she wades through the bureaucratic mess isolated, unsupported and sleep-deprived. Her reality begins to blur.

Hilda is a dog who has a firm belief that she is the master of her human. The story describes everyday activities as interpreted by Hilda. As the best master in the world, Hilda determines the start of each day, their exercise routine, menu, daily walks and social life. Her pet treats Hilda like a goddess who must be venerated.
The ambiguous relationship between a woman, her dog and her partner.

The author’s grandmother was sold as a young girl to be raised by another family, to serve them and eventually become their daughter-in-law. This is a story of the unjust, cruel traditions that used to determine the lives of individuals. It is also a story of resilience through work.

“η μητέρα μου, η θάλασσα” (“My Mother, the Sea”) is a short animated film which explores and symbolically expresses the process of my grieving since the loss of my mother, from her passing until today. This three-year journey is captured allegorically in this film as a weaving of two parallel paths: the mother’s journey to the afterlife and the parallel grieving states of her child. From her last breath to my mourning and the only transient salvation from it. It is an observation of her transition, which her child follows with its personal emotional dissolve.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 10)

films.syn: Nadira from Tajikistan is a breadwinner, a mother and a coal miner. She works in a hazardous environment and is, in fact, raising her child as a single mother. Her husband, who left as a migrant worker, has started a new family elsewhere but still visits from time to time. The film is based on anthropological research.

Under the watchful eye of her gruff grandmother, Gracie the wolf pup trains for “eventual emergencies”. But really, what could possibly happen at the zoo? Inspired by cult author Clive Barker, this horror parody more than makes up for its small budget with neon colours, Jeff-Koons-like zombie creatures and nerdy dialogue humour.
In a quiet and desolate desert, a mysterious phenomenon is revealed – at night, the cacti come to life to perform their nocturnal rituals.

A woman falls head over heels in love with an artist because of his art. She tries various ways to attract his attention. A film that reflects the first moments of love and the challenges of a relationship through a mixture of fictional segments, real events and fragmentary hallucinations. A blurred line between reality and fantasy.
Two little rats running after each other – they’re the kings of the junkyard! But then things escalate, and two teenagers are thrust back into reality.
A squirrel urgently needs a walnut to replenish its winter supplies. When it finds one, a wild chase with a crow begins. Will the squirrel find a way to get all the ingredients for his walnut cake?

Life could be so beautiful if it weren’t for the housing shortage, her ailing mother and the cheeky neighbour boy. Thanks to musical interludes and a heart for the working class, Irene Iborra Rizo’s stop-motion film finds a child-friendly and gracefully unsentimental approach to challenging issues.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 10)

films.syn: Ordinary life repeats itself every day. But the succession of moments that we repeat over and over again is never the same. The moment our body touches something, our consciousness can go to a place that does not exist anywhere in the past, or in the future. Only that moment can be recognised as “now”.

Day in and day out, a sparrow sees images of ostriches everywhere: on posters, in ads and on its smartphone. In awe of the ostriches, with their long necks, dazzling eyes and muscular legs, the little bird wants to be just like them. One thing becomes crystal clear: A sparrow can never truly be an ostrich.

A young woman is overwhelmed by her own mind, consumed by distorted self-perception due to her eating disorder. Is the room getting smaller or is she getting bigger? Her picture-perfect pastel world is slowly drowning her.

Under a bright summer sky, Chloe, Jenny (both 12 years old) and Squeegee (19 years old) share one last ice cream at the local dairy. It’s a poetic animated chronicle of a childhood friendship, its challenges in the face of adolescence, and the first cracks in the friendship.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Camping on the Ocean Floor)

films.syn: Welcome to a place where the houses have holes, tomatoes are ticking bombs and snails wander the streets in search of a safe space. In Paradaïz, Sarajevo-born artist Matea Radic uses absurdist animation, archival images and her own slippery childhood memories to explore the real meaning of home.
When a girl unexpectedly bumps into her childhood best friend, she is torn: should she speak to her friend and reconnect with her? Or should she let the moment pass forever?

Three strange cats, having a good old medieval time! A tapestry full of silly and absurd moments, inspired by the fascinating world of animals in medieval art. A tribute to the colourful way characters are depicted in old manuscripts, in all their perfect imperfection.

ap.p: If You Love Cats, This Is for You!
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: If You Love Cats, This Is for You!)

films.syn: Xiao Zhang and Liu Hong have had each other’s backs since childhood. They are trying to make good money in the city, but it’s 2008 and the global financial crisis hits hard.

films.t: Pilatus – Three Stories From the Mountain
films.syn: The lizard, the lake, the dragon – three original animal fables relating to Lucerne’s local mountain, Mount Pilatus.

A daughter tries to reconcile with her mother through memories of their shared rituals, exposing the intricate aspects of their relationship. As the daughter matures, she begins to contemplate conventional notions of divinity. The blank frames of the 35mm strip regain their function as memorabilia in the process of engraving her past onto its surface.

Feed the monster, have a cup of tea, and if it’s your first day, don’t pay attention to anything peculiar in Sector 3. Nick shows a new worker around the crumbling Progress Mining Company, while Mary tries to get it shut for repairs.
The hand of an invisible illustrator draws a boy and a girl and repeatedly intervenes in their games and disagreements.
In the middle of the night on a mountain road, a man is struck down in a motorcycle accident. That is the cue.

Lea sets off to find a subject for her documentary film. She goes on the hunt armed with her camera and finally meets someone who is not like others. Lea thinks she has finally found her prey, but then the situation changes. She’s the one being hunted.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 10)

films.syn: A filmmaker delves into his personal archive, using a photocopier to repeatedly degrade images and videos, transforming them into ghostly traces of their original form. As the visuals erode, so do the certainties of memory. This experimental film explores the fragility of recollection, where each reproduction distances the image further from its source. Memory becomes an unreliable copy – a fading echo of what once was.
A short story about a boy, a girl, a bee, a flower and the sun, all of whom reject someone or are themselves rejected.
Ray dreams of the beauty and joy he will finally find in retirement.

To get to the oasis, an armadillo and a hare have to cross a road in the desert. Not a difficult thing, you think – but the armadillo is so unlucky that they fail every time. The two stick together and their failure leads them to ever more adventurous ideas.
Robert loves his mummy and his yoghurt.

A man tells of the ups and downs of his adolescence – from the trauma of going to the hairdresser to his first love to the loss of his hair and ultimately of his father. A portrayal that clearly shows how masculinity is constructed.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 10)
Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 10)

films.syn: Ahlam, a 15-year-old girl, tries to escape from Baghdad, the only home she has ever known. At a crowded airport, she battles the lurking shadows and fights for her freedom and her dream of independence.
Two snails made of modelling clay play the leading roles in this slapstick film. Who will win the race for the juicy tomato?

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 10)

films.syn: A boom operator tries to record the sound of mushrooms.
“Splitted” is an abstract animated film that depicts two characters in a divided black-and-white world. Trapped on their respective sides, they desperately try to break free and reach each other.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Kurzfilme in der Kirche)

films.syn: “States of Matter” is an experimental strata-cut animation crafted entirely from wax and paper by shaping solid sculptures out of liquid wax, only to systematically break them down and reanimate them again. Complemented by a tactile soundscape highlighting the materials’ intricate details, textures and movements.
From cave drawings to echo chambers – the history of humankind is a history of storytelling.

One evening, two young Indian women cross paths at the Indian restaurant Sulaimani in Paris. During the meal, unexpected feelings and memories about their migration and emancipation stories arise. Even though their stories are different, they are both gripped by the same nostalgia.

Every spring, the swifts return to the sleepy districts at the edge of the city. But this year, the humans are gone. Only birds and silent spirits inhabit the empty buildings and overgrown courtyards. Through the eyes of the returning swifts, the film reflects on absence, memory and the quiet traces left behind.

After the death of her grandmother, eight-year-old Suzanne takes over her role as a storyteller. Based on Arnošt Goldflam’s short stories, four directors from different countries have created a stop-motion animation film that gently and wittily addresses the subject of transience.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 10)

films.syn: Two strange birds get to know each other over dinner. The owl, a perfect hostess, serves one course after the other. The oystercatcher is in for a long evening of awkward moments and funny silences.

A dark musical enacted in a modern marketplace, situated next to a large freeway. The employees of the various commercial venues deal with boredom and existential anxiety by performing cheerful musical turns. The apocalypse is a tempting liberator.
Old Mr. Johnson makes increasingly desperate attempts to get rid of a little yellow cat that just won’t stay away. Based on the centuries-old folk song of the same name.

ap.p: If You Love Cats, This Is for You!
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: If You Love Cats, This Is for You!)

films.syn: Back in the mists of Victorian times, a sinister man tells his young apprentice the legend of a ferocious feline thief. Is the apprentice struck dumb with fear, or has the cat got his tongue? A dark fantasy with slick animated effects.

ap.p: As if They Were Breathing – Uncanny Puppets in Motion
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: As if They Were Breathing – Uncanny Puppets in Motion)

films.syn: This essay film presents ethical and philosophical questions in a witty way through a journey and the exploration of generative AI.
What happens when dolls meet spiders? A new fear is born: pedioarachnophobia! And it might already be lurking in your home ...

ap.p: As if They Were Breathing – Uncanny Puppets in Motion
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: As if They Were Breathing – Uncanny Puppets in Motion)

films.syn: If the rain were to fall indoors, but never outdoors ... then where would we begin to look for shelter? A place said to give refuge from bad weather or danger? Outside the fence, the bell continues to toll, and if we are not there, then perhaps it’s only a sound that rings out inside of its own mourning. I spoke to myself, he to him, she to her, the ground spoke to the ground, the trees to the tree. Meanwhile inside, that familiar, well-met rain continues to fall.

As the people of a mediaeval village celebrate the beginning of summer, the Royal Family experiences an identity crisis. The King thinks he’s made of glass, the Princess dreams of becoming the King, and the Prince is trapped in the body of a donkey.

films.t: The Great History of Western Philosophy
films.syn: Aria Covamonas’ fantastical cut-out collage brings together historical and pop culture figures from Mao to Mickey Mouse. Like a “cadavre exquis” crafted from publicly available material, this Mexican satire forces us to create our own interpretations in a Dadaist manner.

A talented juggler’s life takes a sudden twist when his treasured juggling balls are stolen. Determined to retrieve his cherished possessions, he embarks on an adventure, aided by acrobatic rabbits, dancing frogs and some shocking truths about his own existence.

Girls in their glittering leotards move lightly on a big carpet performing rhythmic gymnastics. The smiles on their faces hide enormous pressure. Their striving for perfection has accumulated more and more self-dissatisfaction and slowly erodes their team spirit.

A man looks like he needs a job. Another man comes with a proposal – the job offered is simple: it only requires listening to music and pulling levers. This economic arrangement favours simplicity and compliance through looking away and mishearing.
Without words, the film tells the story of an Irish fisherman. The tragedy of his life is reflected in a beer glass. The fisherman makes a decision.

Two babies are about to be born. One of them is bound to be a regular child. The other is destined to be a trickster. But how can you tell them apart, since the birth of identical twins is in itself a trick of nature! Nobody knows what will happen next. It is said that when somewhere a trickster is born, the hazard lights on all the cars light up by themselves.

A man and a woman are having a candlelit dinner at a restaurant. All of a sudden, the man’s appearance begins to change. “The Lovers” is a stop motion relationship horror film and an unromantic comedy about a couple confronted with escalating physical transformations.

ap.p: As if They Were Breathing – Uncanny Puppets in Motion
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: As if They Were Breathing – Uncanny Puppets in Motion)

films.syn: Selinna Ajamikoko is a Nigerian woman who travelled across the Mediterranean Sea pursuing the chance of a better life and her dream of becoming a meatseller, just as her mother was back home. Despite being exposed to a multitude of harassments and acts of violence, Selinna firmly remains the decision-maker in her life.

Mixing clay, object animation, cut-out and pixilation techniques, the author mediates the strong, decisive and creative character of her grandmother. Vera, a seamstress and a vet, cares for a piglet who was incidentally injured by its mother.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 10)

films.syn: Dawn is gathering medicinal herbs in the forest when the woodcutter who is in love with her appears. He offers her his hand and his heart, but Dawn makes fun of him. Shortly after, Dawn is attacked by the servants of a mysterious beast, who kidnap the girl. Dawn manages to cut loose her shadow, whose quest it is to find help and solve the mystery.
The fleeting moments before the local Obon, a Buddhist summer festival with food, dancing and performances. Impatient children, board game dice, and fruit stickers flash by and play like a memory.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Camping on the Ocean Floor)

films.syn: The workers of our brave new hybrid world annotate and segment images; everything has to be labelled and assigned to categories. This documentary work, deriving from new media aesthetics, thematises global divisions within labour structures and the consequences of accelerating digitalisation.

In this music video, cats gather for a protest. The South Korean song speaks about poverty and inequality and was a popular protest song in 2021, until the government banned it from being performed in public.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 10)

films.syn: A tiger at the zoo is terribly bored. Until he gets an unexpected visit from a goat. The goat not only upsets his habits, but also stirs up conflicting feelings in him. The story of an extraordinary friendship.
Alex and Christy’s night off goes horribly wrong when Christy’s baby brother goes missing. After a long night of searching, all hope seems lost. Until they hear a familiar earth-shattering voice.

A woman meets a hedgehog. The hedgehog is the one she has been waiting for. So begins an autumn delirium amidst the lonely confines of a Soviet suburban neighbourhood, where reality and dreams merge and humans discover their animalistic side. The man doesn’t realize the changes in the woman until it’s too late.

A telephone conversation between friends who remember their plan to go skinny dipping at night while spending a weekend together. However, they have so much fun making the plan that they never actually carry it out.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Camping on the Ocean Floor)

films.syn: A sleeping piece of paper is woken by the flapping wings of a Tsuru, a Japanese origami bird. This Brazilian stop-motion film artfully tells the story of a challenging search for transformation.

films.t: TV oder Die Ruhestörung an der Waldbergstrasse
films.syn: Six-year-old Diego exceeds his screen time and ends up with square eyes. This triggers a series of mysterious phenomena seeping through various screens in the apartment building. When police officers arrive to investigate a noise complaint, they must face fictional threats come to life.
Léonie shows Rose the village where she was born. It’s an opportunity to take a stroll through the sunny streets and down memory lane.

The Sister remembers that her Brother had dark eyes, hair like her own, shoulders as fragile as a bird’s wings, and that he knew the way to the river by heart. The Sister has forgotten nothing about her Brother.
Hazel finds it difficult to tell her overworked mother what is bothering her. Until she realises that her drawings can help her to express what she cannot say out loud.
The east wind begins to blow, carrying warmth into the water. Landscapes merge without boundaries, and in time, the mountains drift into slumber.

The story of a young adult who travels into her mind space, an amusement park filled with rides representing her psyche and creatures reminiscent of her thoughts and feelings. On this journey, she learns to make peace with herself through meeting and interacting with her inner child.
A sand figure and a baby turtle meet in the dunes. Together they set off for the ocean, where they both learn what it means to be part of each other's world – until the tide comes in.

Created frame by frame from over 500 feet of woven fabric, this short film reimagines the mysterious disappearance of the filmmaker’s great-great-great-great-grandmother, who left her home one day and was never seen again. An exploration of memory, transformation and the threads that connect family and place.

This profoundly meaningful “casual fantasy” is narrated by Marianne Faithful. We witness dangers, twists and turns within a she-salmon’s life cycle. A fragile creature born from her mother’s sacrifice struggles with natural enemies but also faces the most dreadful one –humans.

She is a mother and a wife, but above all, a firefighter. This is a dreadful and fascinating job, making her fearful, tired, yet determined never to give up. It is forest fire season. She keeps fighting against the natural elements, in sync with her own nature.
Helpless in the face of a repressive state, a young couple leaves their home, but their escape turns into a surreal nightmare.

When a perfectionist illustrator accidentally makes an ink blot, Wolfie is born – a little wolf with an ink nose. This touching Czech animated film tells of the freedom that comes from facing up to your own mistakes.

A mix of pixilation, live-action, and photography-based collage takes us into the controlled chaos of a war reporter’s mind. The film is inspired by Francesca Borri’s reporting from Syria in 2013, and the female director and actor gives the film its somewhat erratic but deeply humanistic style.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 10)

films.syn: A widowed elderly man feels lonely. Then he sees an advert in the bakery for a local knitting club. A heart-warming stop-motion film about the power of community.

Yuck! Couples who kiss on the mouth are gross. And the worst thing is that you can’t miss them: when people want to kiss, their lips turn pink and shiny. Little Léo laughs at them, just like all the other children at summer camp. But he has a secret he won’t tell his friends: his own mouth actually starts to shine. And in reality, Léo really wants to kiss someone.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Camping on the Ocean Floor)

films.syn: Five monkeys steal one man’s greatest possession. Will he be able to get it back?
One man’s scramble through the hustle and bustle of Cairo’s chaotic streets. Will he make it on time?
An astronaut and his robot land on a dangerous planet and are swallowed by it. Can they escape the monsters inside?

The ocean is a paradise for shrimp Fran. With her deadly claws, she takes whatever she wants. For blind fish Milva, it’s a daily fight for survival. Fran finds her beautiful and wants her to see the ocean in the same way she does. Can these two overcome their differences?

In a world where every person is born with a bird that embodies their inner potential, aman and his feathered companion drift further and further apart. Will they find their way back to each other? A whimsical fairy tale about the search for oneself.
You are trying to enjoy a quiet pint in the pub but a patron and his son seem to have a problem with your demeanour.

A small, daydreaming squirrel wishes for nothing more than the sun to never stop shining. But when the rain really disappears forever, nature begins to suffer ... This story shows us why we need the sun and rain in equal measure.
A woman living in a house that drifts like cosmic debris wakes to find her right ear and her husband gone. To recover what was lost, she embarks on a surreal journey through the void.

An archetypal portrait of every place that has been abandoned, where the village becomes a living being, first left alone by men and then illuminated by the light of a fire that evokes a possible return, in the eternal repetition of the before and after of life and death.

Having scraped together enough money to pay for an abortion after her Polish exchange student boyfriend got her pregnant, the director decides to celebrate with a party. In attendance are her geriatric ska musician neighbour, semi-retired gang members, her grubby gay roommate and the ever-present bedbugs.

From the mind of one of the 20th century’s most innovativeabstract filmmakers, “Abstronic” combines abstraction and electronics to produce a playful flow of images reminiscent of an abstract painting in motion. Bute, who was also a painter, created the film using electronic images which were produced by a specially designed oscilloscope and combined with traditional animation.

ap.p: Midnight Snack: The Video Synthesizer. Exploring a Lost History of Electronic Animation
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Midnight Snack: The Video Synthesizer. Exploring a Lost History of Electronic Animation)

films.t: All My Scars Vanish in the Wind
films.syn: A woman hears a disturbing callcoming from within and follows it as far as her inner child. Atmospheric images and the absence of conventional narrative structures create an intense, dreamlike experience, depicting vulnerability, memory and inner transformation.

During an alien invasion, Rita finds herself trapped in a time loop that feels like a computer game. In stark contrast to the live-action film starring Tom Cruise, the anime version of “All You Need Is Kill” focuses on the female protagonist and captivates audiences with its expressive aesthetics and bold colours.

Whilst searching for his aunt, ten-year-old Birahima becomes embroiled as a child soldier in the civil wars of Liberia and Sierra Leone. A film adaptation told with unsentimental empathy and a keen sense of the power of words.

As Italy’s answer to Disney’s “Fantasia”, six animated short films have been set to classical music. Bruno Bozzetto’s magnum opus, which celebrates its 50th anniversary this year, is brimming with delightful humour, creative ideas and satirical digs at modern consumer society.

Just in time for the start of winter, two little stoats face a big task: they have toswap their brown summer coats for white winter fur. But as if that wasn’t difficult enough, a hunter suddenly appears and everything becomes even more complicated.
When a young woman is asked to speak in front of a crowd, panic overwhelms her. Will she find the courage to face her fear on a journey among fish and stars?

A white-haired girl, an egg and a young wanderer. That was all Mamoru Oshii and the illustrator Yoshitaka Amano needed, ten years before “Ghost in the Shell”, to create a visually stunning, intensely atmospheric science-fiction meditation that leaves room for individual interpretation.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Angel’s Egg – Restored Version)

films.syn: DeWitt, Sorensen and Winkler were a dream team of artist-engineers; a talented group whose fluency in new media and technology would go on to win them numerous awards and accolades. Their skills in videosynthesis and processing are clearly visible in this dreamy, psychedelic drift through synthesised new age landscapes made of vapourwave colours and swirling, fractal-like shapes.

ap.p: Midnight Snack: The Video Synthesizer. Exploring a Lost History of Electronic Animation
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Midnight Snack: The Video Synthesizer. Exploring a Lost History of Electronic Animation)

films.syn: Olivia, a young woman living abroad, returns to her hometown in Mexico in the hope of reconnecting with her past but also understanding the history of violence against women in Mexico.

ap.p: Midnight Snack: The Video Synthesizer. Exploring a Lost History of Electronic Animation
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Midnight Snack: The Video Synthesizer. Exploring a Lost History of Electronic Animation)

films.syn: In “Au coeur de l’hiver” (In the heart of the winter), we observe how five forest dwellers, with varying degrees of success, prudence and craftiness, augment their food supplies in order to survive the winter. Isabelle Favez has turned this struggle into a simple, bitter-sweet tale that will touch children and adults alike.
In the 1990s, eight-year-old Agata leaves Poland for Belgium. Her perspective transforms the reality of migration into an initiatory experience.
Spoon finds a coupon for a paradise.

While grieving the loss of his wife, a father grapples with faith in an effort to reconnect with her; the journey is portrayed as death being a beginning rather than an end, a simple line separating two worlds.

When a light goes on in the middle of the jungle, the insects are thrown into turmoil – much to the delight of the hungry bats nearby! With plenty of humour and poetry, this nocturnal adventure raises awareness of light pollution.

When the bedroom travels with you, the extraordinary becomes commonplace. On the Côte d’Azur, the sea breeze blows in your face; in the Alps, dinner is cooking at sunset. An animated account of life in a bus.
A sick and tired teapot is given a recipe for better health and good flavour. Advertisement for Bentlyes tea.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 11)

films.syn: A telephone answering machine is activated and all the messages it contains are played. We hear the sounds of twelve different birds and see a hand trying to find signs, symbols, letters to contain what has been uttered. The symbols evolve to a language of far more than just the sounds of birds.
The Crow invites the birds of the garden to a night of dancing in celebration of the Wagtail’s birthday, the most beloved of all the birds.

When his parents air their own problems in front of the school psychologist, 16-year-old Blaise would rather vanish into the floor. Gradually, such laconic scenes build into a revealing satire on insecurity, miscommunication and botched rebellions.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Music Video Darlings Vol. 11)

films.syn: A young writer is carried off into the wonderful world of books by her idea that has come to life. Amid adventures, discoveries and doubts, she learns that creating is not always easy ... and that sometimes you simply have to let go.

Nine-year old Elisabeth would actually prefer to spend the summer in the city. But when her little brother disappears in the Venezuelan rainforest, she discovers a truly mystical world. Using child-friendly imagery, Edmunds Jansons tells a story of courage and a mysterious mythical creature.

As the Moroccan director Bouchra chronicles her personal exploration of queer identity on film, the narrative layers become increasingly blurred. For this autobiographically inspired piece of metafiction, Meriem Bennani and Orian Yani Barki combine minimally animated animal figures with real-life backgrounds.

ap.p: Aardman 50 Years: A Focus on Female Creativity
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Aardman 50 Years: A Focus on Female Creativity)

films.syn: In 1840 Seville, a street boy and a pickpocket try to save the charismatic Carmen from her foretold fate. Sébastien Laudenbach translates the plot of Bizet’s opera into a contemporary, visually stunning plea for solidarity and resistance.

A dead bird in the garden raises questions for a four-year-old. To protect her daughter from harsh reality, a mother invents an alternative world. Together, they escape into the logic of cartoons, where anything is possible.

“Songs of Animals” is a series of short animated episodes that tell whimsical and humorous stories centred on different animals: “The Crocodile” and “The Crow”. Through simple yet intricate lines and visually stunning frames, the series showcases the brilliance of Ihab Shaker’s storytelling. Bringing traditional Egyptian cultural motifs to life in French, it creates a cross-cultural hybrid that was truly ahead of its time.

“Where do we want to go?” This question does not come from an ancient Greek philosopher but from a dysfunctional, nihilistic GPS device. Switch on at your own risk. An attempt to follow a constantly changing route and not end up in the scenery.

films.t: Chicken Run: Dawn of the Nugget (Excerpt)

ap.p: Aardman 50 Years: A Focus on Female Creativity
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Aardman 50 Years: A Focus on Female Creativity)

films.syn: A man can stop and restart time with a snap of his fingers, until one day time no longer starts again.

ap.p: Midnight Snack: We Are Human, After All
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Midnight Snack: We Are Human, After All)

films.syn: A woman has a frog inside her body. She tries to keep it there but the frog keeps demanding more space.

ap.p: Aardman 50 Years: A Focus on Female Creativity
ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Aardman 50 Years: A Focus on Female Creativity)

films.syn: The journey of fear and struggle of “Kernel K-500” who rebels againstthe cruelty of apartheid and the condescending perception of his kind. Moments before his salvation, the unexpected occurs.

Living with an unacknowledged mental disorder, Adela seeks answers in popular rituals. She feels that something is watching and harming her, and seems to only find understanding in religion. During a visit to a healer, she confesses the disturbing origin of her suffering.
On an intergalactic cruise for singles, lonely souls chase a kiss, a caress or just a glimpse of love among the stars.

A union between two artists and their two mediums of expression: celluloid film and electronic video. Beck, the young inventor of his own video synthesiser, and Belson, a famed abstract filmmaker and animation artist twice his age, spent two years working together on this journey through spheres of thought, mysticism and form. Deeply psychedelic and yet with all the weightlessness of light.

ap.p: Midnight Snack: The Video Synthesizer. Exploring a Lost History of Electronic Animation

films.syn: Two lovers embark on a journey through acolourful, constantly transforming world. But something unstoppable lurks amidst the hand-painted colours, disturbing their idyll.

At once playful and profound, the film creates its own internal rhythm, exploring the depth of what is felt but remains unsaid.

films.syn: The story unfolds in a distant future, a time when machines have risen to claim dominion over the planet. A world drowned in darkness where artificial intelligence rules with an iron fist and humanity survives only in its shadow.
A short animated film about the tense relationship between humans and the wolf.

In a colourful and slightly chaotic world, little beings chase after time. Between an hourglass that never seems to run out and days that fly by far too quickly, each creature lives at its very own pace. Is it ever possible to catch up with lost time?

Drawing inspiration from traditional weaving techniques, oral storytelling and contemporary modes of production, “Tiɣrist: Threads of Exile” invites reflection on textile as a language of resistance and a vessel of memory – a sensitive archive.
A proud urban planner defends his “visionary” cycle lane designs to his superiors. On the streets outside the conference room, his “perfect” plans plunge the city into chaos.
The priest of an ancient sun cult crosses the wasteland of his lost planet in search of enlightenment for his people and himself.

Anna sets off for a walk in the snow. Along the way, she meets a mischievous little bunny who whisks her away on a joyful winter adventure. Amid wild chases and games of hide-and-seek, this gentle outing turns into a magical experience.

These films show the capabilities of the Animac analogue computer, predecessor to the Scanimate videosynthesiser which would later kickstart a new era in motion graphics during the 1970s. The Animac’ssweeping and fluid forms, created using manually controlled cathode rays which drew on screen in real time, give an early example of electronically designed and animated characters.

films.syn: During their holiday, two young women get lost in a rainforest. After wandering around for days, their irritation with one another grows. While increasingly dreaming about ice cream, they become conscious of their own vulnerability.
A lamppost struggles with the noise and chaos of Egypt’s new motorists.
Battling boredom, a little boy gets trapped in the boot of a car. When he gets out, he’s no longer the same.
The house, the garden, the old rusty basin, the wind… everything has its mystery and its soul. Children know how to sense it.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Midnight Snack: We Are Human, After All)

films.syn: In three short stories, a man discovers a shower, a bird and a machine. What could possibly go wrong?
Blooming, fading, transformation: In a continuous cycle, colourful modelling clay flows rhythmically into itself, constantly giving rise to new forms.

Maxence is eating the scabs off his knees. Octave is bored, Aude and Marika are playing cards, Victor is sick and Emi is looking out the window. At the back of the bus taking them to summer camp, eight children talk about their daily lives through stories personally experienced or heard by the author.

A suitcase full of money not only revitalises an unhappy relationship but also causes havoc and tension between three bank robbers. «Valise» is a film about greed, cheap suitcases and a fortunate dog.
“Vegnir ord la calorgna”, Romansh for “getting up”, tells the story of discovering a passion in the form of an animated short film.

In an animation studio, a little monkey comes to life. When he sees a beautiful, glowing jungle on a monitor, his thirst for adventure takes hold and, together with two friends, he builds a world of his own. The film illustrates the power that the imagination can unleash.
Capucine’s physical pain becomes increasingly unbearable. Eventually, she consults a doctor. The diagnosis: a goblin has taken up residence in her body and planted weeds everywhere.
A short musical, using a novel technique of animated azulejos (painted tiles), in which a rebellious Mary joins her voice with those of celebrated women of history in the struggle for equality.

A study on texture, amorphous forms and the body via image processing and video synthesis. Beginning as a simple exercise in contrast and keying effects, the electronic eye of the video camera begins to hallucinate more and more as it tracks the artist through a series of oblique experiments, before finally breaking down completely, recreating reality as a vibrating electronic mesh.

films.syn: In a magical world full of strawberries, dreamer Glitzeri creates beautiful, sparkling water fountains. But his happiness is dampened by the other animals. If only they could recognise the beauty hidden beneath the surface.

Though shy, Tsubasa is equally fascinated and annoyed by his eccentric classmate Gyotaro. With shifting perspectives and subtle portrayal of characters, this featurefilm debut paints a complex picture of friends drifting apart that goes well beyond the boundaries of a classic coming-of-age story.

This world moves in repetitions, like waves that endlessly come and go. Within it, a woman walks. She passes through stages of her life. A wind blows in from the west, she turns to face a quiet sunset, together with the sun she fades beyond the horizon.
The fragility of Earth's future, the uncertainty of life are among the core concepts director Páraic McGloughlin explores in this music video for Weval, a duo from the Kompakt label.

A TV courtroom show: a man, a woman, one evening together, contradictory versions of what happened. Broadcast disruption –we’ll return to the programme shortly. Who is telling the truth and whom do you believe?
Man-made disaster threatens to destroy California’s redwood forests. But the forest dwellers, among them a tree spirit, do everything they can to avert this fate and save their ecosystem.

In the city of Bern, strange little creatures suddenly appear, dancing and playing to the rhythm of the music. Drawn directly onto the film reel, this experimental film transforms the urban backdrop into a playground full of movement, sounds and surprises.

Didier remembers. In the intimacy of his daily life, he recounts his memories of love and loneliness, of what is hidden and whatremains. The film questions how memories build our identity, while raising awareness of the struggles and hardships that queer seniors face throughout their lives.
